checkpoint.scope: On-disk settings only; game memory/closed-client state not asserted. No settings writes, profiling changes, or game input.

request: User reported both aura/timer and frame/name/health/border preview divergence; rework shared rendering rules while retaining layout and secure integration.
changes: One FluxRaidCellVisualTemplate supplies live and preview artwork; secure live behavior and plain preview scripts remain separate.
One owned-health-bounds aura layout serves both renderers; preview clips each side with two owned public hosts.
One duration style fits canonical dimensions then applies overall and independent font scale, matching native initialization/parent scaling.
Shared health formatter supports all five modes and dead/offline states; real preview tokens use live values with secret guards.
Preview center status reuses shared live host/layer; overflow atlas/width/offset and prediction sample colors/order match live; native-sized center markers.
Readable large aura X scaling corrected; preview aura background added to match the native XML sink.
preserved: Positions, reverse columns/native member ordering, connected border policy, saved scope/values, counts/strict filters, opacity, cooldown swipes and Flux bindings. X/font native initialization still requires reload, documented by the existing controls.
